type Boxes<T> = { [K in keyof T]: { value: T[K] } };
function unwrap<T>(boxes: Boxes<T>): T {
  const result: any = Array.isArray(boxes) ? [] : {};
  for (const key in boxes) result[key] = boxes[key].value;
  return result;
}
function firsts<T>(boxes: { [K in keyof T]: T[K][] }): T {
  const result: any = {};
  for (const key in boxes) result[key] = boxes[key][0];
  return result;
}
function restricted<T extends { name: string }>(boxes: Boxes<T>): T {
  return unwrap(boxes);
}
function masked<T>(boxes: { readonly [K in keyof T]?: { value: T[K] } }): T {
  const result: any = {};
  for (const key in boxes) result[key] = boxes[key]?.value;
  return result;
}
const result = unwrap({ name: { value: 'alice' }, age: { value: 12 } });
const arrays = firsts({ name: ['list'], age: [20] });
const tuple: readonly [{ value: number }, { value: string }] = [{ value: 3 }, { value: 'tuple' }];
const reversed: readonly [number, string] = unwrap(tuple);
const extended = restricted({ name: { value: 'bound' }, extra: { value: 7 } });
const mutable = masked({ first: { value: 9 } } as const);
mutable.first = 9;
const dictionary: Record<string, { value: number }> = { direct: { value: 5 } };
const unwrappedIndex: Record<string, number> = unwrap(dictionary);
console.log(result.name.toUpperCase(), result.age + 1, arrays.name, arrays.age, reversed[0], reversed[1], extended.name, extended.extra, mutable.first, unwrappedIndex.direct);
